repos.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.

aiSummary.summary: Anthropic 官方维护的 Claude Code 插件目录，包含内部及第三方高质量插件。支持通过 Claude Code 系统直接安装，遵循标准化插件结构。开发者需注意安全风险，且插件名称发布后不可更改。适用于需要扩展 Claude Code 功能的用户。
aiSummary.summary_en: Official Anthropic-managed directory for Claude Code plugins.
aiSummary.useCase: 用于发现、安装和管理 Claude Code 插件，扩展 AI 助手功能。
aiSummary.useCase_en: A centralized marketplace for discovering and installing high-quality Claude Code plugins.

repos.description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个基于 Claude Code 的本地 AI 求职框架，使用 Python 实现自动化工作流。它能评估职位匹配度、定制简历与求职信，并辅助面试准备。项目针对丹麦市场优化，但核心流程可扩展至其他地区，旨在提升求职效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code to automate resume tailoring, cover letter writing, and interview prep.
aiSummary.useCase: 自动化求职申请流程，提升求职效率
aiSummary.useCase_en: Automates the job application process by using AI to evaluate postings, tailor CVs, and write cover letters.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

aiSummary.summary: ECC 是一个代理工具包性能优化系统，旨在为 Claude Code、Codex 等提供协调的工程系统。它集成了技能、记忆和安全功能，通过规划、测试、审查等流程优化上下文窗口，支持多种 AI 编程工具，提升开发效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: An engineering coordination system that optimizes AI agent performance with memory, skills, and workflows.
aiSummary.useCase: 为 AI 编程助手提供工程化工作流和优化工具，用于提升代码质量和开发效率。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To provide AI coding agents with a coordinated engineering system for planning, testing, and memory management.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/

aiSummary.summary: CLI-Anything 旨在让所有软件具备“代理原生”能力，通过 CLI-Hub 平台连接 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor）与各类软件工具。用户可安装社区构建的 CLI 工具，使 AI 代理通过命令行执行复杂任务，生成 CAD、3D 场景、游戏等实际工件。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Python project bridging AI agents and software via a centralized CLI registry.
aiSummary.useCase: 使 AI 代理能够通过命令行接口自动化使用各类软件工具并生成实际工件。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Enables AI agents to interact with software tools through a unified, installable CLI registry.

repos.description: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist. The #1 Agent Skills library for science, used by 250,000+ scientists worldwide. 177 ready-to-use validated skills plus 100+ scientific databases covering biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. Compatible with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, and the open Agent Skills standard.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个为 AI 科学家提供 177 个科学技能库的项目，涵盖生物、化学、医学、物理等多个领域。它遵循 Agent Skills 标准，兼容 Cursor、Claude Code 等多种工具。项目还推出了 K-Dense BYOK，允许用户在本地运行免费开源的 AI co-scientist，保护数据隐私。
aiSummary.summary_en: A library of 177 validated scientific skills to turn AI agents into researchers.
aiSummary.useCase: 将 AI 代理转化为 AI 科学家，用于生物、化学、医学等领域的科研工作。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To provide validated workflows and databases for AI agents conducting scientific research.

repos.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个为AI编程助手提供长期记忆的Rust项目。它允许用户在不同编程工具（如Claude Code、Cursor等）之间无缝切换，共享记忆和上下文。项目支持跨项目、跨机器的记忆存储，通过本地服务器管理，确保用户在不同代理间交接任务时无需重复解释架构或历史，极大提升了开发效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: Shared memory server for AI coding agents to facilitate seamless handoffs and context continuity between different tools.
aiSummary.useCase: 多AI编程工具间的无缝切换与上下文共享
aiSummary.useCase_en: Facilitates seamless handoffs between different AI coding agents by providing a shared, persistent memory server.

aiSummary.summary: 这是一个为 AI 代理优化的 Android 开发技能库，提供模块化的 Markdown 指令和资源，帮助 LLM 理解并执行 Android 开发最佳实践，特别关注 LLM 表现不佳的复杂工作流。
aiSummary.summary_en: A collection of AI-optimized skills for Android development best practices.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于增强 AI 代理在 Android 开发中的特定任务执行能力和代码质量。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To provide AI agents with modular instructions for complex Android workflows.

repos.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

aiSummary.summary: Orca 是一个 AI 编排平台，旨在帮助开发者高效管理多个 AI 编码代理（如 Claude、Codex）。它支持并行工作树、移动端监控、SSH 远程执行及原生 GitHub/Linear 集成，允许用户在一个界面中对比和合并不同 AI 的代码生成结果，提升开发效率。
aiSummary.summary_en: An AI orchestrator for managing coding agents like Claude and Codex in parallel worktrees.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于需要同时运行多个 AI 编码助手、进行代码并行测试或远程协作开发的场景。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Run multiple AI coding agents simultaneously in isolated worktrees to compare results and manage projects efficiently.

repos.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal, understands your codebase, and helps you code faster by executing routine tasks, explaining complex code, and handling git workflows - all through natural language commands.

aiSummary.summary: Claude Code 是一个运行在终端中的代理编码工具，基于 TypeScript 开发。它利用自然语言命令理解代码库，帮助开发者执行常规任务、解释复杂代码以及处理 Git 工作流，从而提升编码效率。支持多种安装方式，并包含可扩展的插件系统。
aiSummary.summary_en: An agentic coding tool for the terminal that automates tasks and handles git workflows using natural language.
aiSummary.useCase: 适用于希望通过自然语言命令快速执行代码任务、理解代码逻辑及自动化 Git 操作的开发者。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To assist developers in executing routine tasks and handling git workflows through natural language commands in the term

repos.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

aiSummary.summary: VoiceStudio 是一个开源、完全本地化的 ElevenLabs 替代品。它支持语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录及有声书创作，覆盖 646 种语言。项目基于 Electron 开发，支持 NVIDIA GPU、Apple Silicon 及 CPU 运行，提供本地 API 和 MCP 支持，适合个人和企业进行本地化语音处理。
aiSummary.summary_en: Open-source, local alternative to ElevenLabs for voice cloning, dubbing, and transcription.
aiSummary.useCase: 适合个人和企业进行本地化语音处理、视频配音及 AI 语音助手开发。
aiSummary.useCase_en: Create voice clones, dub videos, and transcribe audio locally using your own hardware.

aiSummary.summary: OpenCode 是一个基于 TypeScript 的开源 AI 编码代理，提供命令行工具和桌面应用，支持跨平台（Windows、macOS、Linux）使用，旨在辅助开发者进行代码编写与自动化任务。
aiSummary.summary_en: An open-source AI coding agent with CLI and desktop app support.
aiSummary.useCase: 辅助开发者进行代码编写、编辑和自动化编程任务。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To assist developers in writing and managing code using AI.

repos.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated

aiSummary.summary: Ruflo 是一个专为 Claude Code 和 Codex 设计的 Agent 元框架。它通过提供工具、记忆、循环和沙箱，赋予 AI 模型执行能力。项目支持部署智能多玩家 swarms、协调自主工作流，并具备自适应记忆、自学习智能和联邦通信功能，旨在让 AI 代理不仅运行，还能协作。
aiSummary.summary_en: An agent harness for Claude Code and Codex that enables intelligent multi-player swarms and autonomous workflows.
aiSummary.useCase: 部署智能多玩家 swarms，协调自主工作流，构建对话式 AI 系统
aiSummary.useCase_en: Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms and coordinate autonomous workflows within Claude Code and Codex environments.

repos.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep (1974 tool). One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. It’s durable and can replace ElasticSearch saving you x10 infra costs.

aiSummary.summary: XERJ 是一个用 Rust 编写的本地 AI 搜索工具，能够自动索引代码、文档和日志。它通过智能索引大幅减少 token 消耗（比 grep 少 40 倍），支持参考编码和代理记忆。它旨在替代 ElasticSearch，帮助 AI Agent 快速定位代码片段，降低基础设施成本。
aiSummary.summary_en: A Rust-based local AI search tool that indexes code and documents to help coding agents find information faster and cheaper.
aiSummary.useCase: 专为 AI 编码助手和本地知识库管理设计，用于高效检索代码片段和文档。
aiSummary.useCase_en: To enable coding agents to search and reuse code from indexed repositories to reduce token usage and improve efficiency.
